생선.t: 생선 is fish as food; a live, swimming fish is 물고기.

좁다.e: Opposite of 넓다. 방이 좁아요 = the room is cramped.

꼭.forms: 꼭 + verb: 꼭 오세요, 꼭 가고 싶어요
꼭.x: Please be sure to come again next time.
꼭.e: 꼭 오세요 = Be sure to come; 꼭 안아요 = hug tight.

장마.ex: 한국은 여름에 장마 때문에 비가 많이 와요.
장마.x: In Korea it rains a lot in summer because of the rainy season.
장마.e: Korea's summer rainy season, usually from late June to late July.

당황스럽다.x: I was taken aback when my friend suddenly got angry.

당기다.m: to pull; to move up (a date); to crave (food)
당기다.x: Don't push this door; pull it.
당기다.e: Opposite of 밀다 'to push': door signs read 미세요 and 당기세요.
당기다.t: With food it means 'crave': 오늘은 매운 음식이 당겨요 'I'm craving something spicy today.'

몹시.x: I was terribly tired yesterday, so I went to bed early.
몹시.t: Usually describes negative or intense states — cold, tired, worried — rather than pleasant ones.

상여금.x: The company gives a bonus at the holidays.
상여금.t: In speech 보너스 is more common; 상여금 appears in contracts and the news.

대표작.ex: 이 영화는 그 감독의 대표작 중 하나예요.
대표작.x: This film is one of that director's best-known works.

비관적.ex: 전문가들은 경제 전망을 비관적으로 보고 있습니다.
비관적.x: Experts are taking a pessimistic view of the economic outlook.

압류.m: seizure, confiscation (of property by court order)
압류.ex: 세금을 내지 않아서 그의 자동차가 압류되었어요.
압류.x: His car was seized because he didn't pay his taxes.

상관관계.ex: 연구진은 수면 시간과 성적 사이의 상관관계를 분석했습니다.
상관관계.x: The researchers analyzed the correlation between sleep time and grades.
상관관계.t: 상관관계가 있다 'there is a correlation'; contrast with 인과관계 'causation'.

혹한.x: The severe cold of minus 20 degrees has continued for a week.
혹한.t: Pronounced [호칸] — ㄱ and ㅎ merge into ㅋ.

성취하다.m: to achieve, to accomplish, to attain
성취하다.x: He achieved his dream through constant effort.

일률적으로.m: uniformly, across the board, without exception
일률적으로.ex: 모든 학생에게 일률적으로 같은 규칙을 적용할 수는 없어요.
일률적으로.x: You can't apply the same rule uniformly to every student.
일률적으로.e: Literally 'by one rule' — the same standard for everyone.
일률적으로.t: Pronounced [일률쩌그로], with a doubled ㄹ sound: illyul.

울며 겨자 먹기로.forms: 울며 겨자 먹기로 ~하다 · 울며 겨자 먹기예요
울며 겨자 먹기로.m: grudgingly, against one's will, having no choice
울며 겨자 먹기로.ex: 다른 방법이 없어서 울며 겨자 먹기로 비싼 표를 샀어요.
울며 겨자 먹기로.x: There was no other way, so I grudgingly bought the expensive ticket.
울며 겨자 먹기로.e: Literally 'eating mustard while crying': doing something unpleasant because you must.
울며 겨자 먹기로.t: A well-known proverb; also used as a noun: 울며 겨자 먹기예요 'It's a bitter pill to swallow.'

문화적.ex: 두 나라 사이에는 문화적 차이가 커요.
문화적.x: There are big cultural differences between the two countries.
문화적.e: -적 = '-ic/-al', turning nouns into modifiers: 문화적, 사회적, 역사적.
문화적.t: Use 문화적 right before a noun; elsewhere use 문화적인 or 문화적으로.

징계하다.m: to discipline, to take disciplinary action
징계하다.x: The company disciplined the employee who broke the rules.

환차익.ex: 달러 가치가 오르면서 수출 기업들이 큰 환차익을 얻었어요.
환차익.x: As the dollar rose, exporters made big currency gains.

백년해로.m: a couple growing old happily together
백년해로.x: I sincerely hope you two will grow old happily together.
백년해로.e: Literally 'a hundred years, growing old together'.
백년해로.t: A classic wedding wish; pronounced [뱅년해로] — nasalization.

창출하다.m: to create, to generate (jobs, value, profits)
창출하다.ex: 새 공장은 많은 일자리를 창출할 것입니다.
창출하다.x: The new factory will create many jobs.

성소수자.ex: 성소수자에 대한 차별을 금지하는 법이 논의되고 있습니다.
성소수자.x: A law banning discrimination against sexual minorities is being discussed.
성소수자.e: Literally 'sexual-minority person'; 소수 means 'small number, minority'.

역발산기개세.m: enormous strength and spirit, mighty enough to move mountains
역발산기개세.x: That general displayed might enough to uproot mountains.
역발산기개세.e: From Xiang Yu's song: 'strength to uproot mountains, spirit to cover the world'.
역발산기개세.t: Unlike most four-character idioms, this one has six syllables.
